mermaid.min.js — vendored mermaid UMD build
===========================================

Package
    mermaid@11.17.0

Global name exposed by the bundle
    mermaid (window.mermaid; utils/mermaid.ts calls initialize, run, detectType, and
    registerLayoutLoaders)

Source
    The package's own prebuilt file, copied verbatim:
    node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js

Exact command
    mkdir /tmp/mermaid-vendor && cd /tmp/mermaid-vendor
    npm init -y
    npm install mermaid@11.17.0
    cp node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js <frontend>/public/vendor/

Output checksum (sha256)
    8d8e0eec56d3a83b4b3c87f42050845546dee93ebe1875d2117c12e6947c0cb3

Output size
    3572296 bytes (~3.4 MiB)

Version coupling
    mermaid-layout-elk/ (see mermaid-layout-elk.provenance.txt) bundles a
    copy of mermaid 11.17.0's internals. Upgrade both together.
